Harper Lin: Hi everyone :wave: I'm Harper, starting today on Platform (PDT). Laptop arrives this afternoon. Quick q: who should I ping for VPN/MDM and registry access? Also, is someone my buddy? Tiny fun fact: I play the ukulele badly but enthusiastically.

Jordan Lee: Welcome Harper! :tada: I'm Jordan  your buddy for the first month. Ping me for pairing, dotfiles, and bad ukulele jokes. For VPN/MDM tag IT Support and Samira for the onboarding tracker.

IT Support: Welcome Harper  MDM invite will be sent to harper.lin@example.com once you confirm your email here. After enrolling, generate an ed25519 key and upload the pubkey at https://id.redwood/internal-keys. For registry access open an infra ticket and tag us with your employee ID.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Harper Lin! A profile was created and the intro circle invite will be sent shortly. Please enroll in MDM and confirm here.

Marta Ruiz: Hi Harper :wave: I submitted the hardware request for a 24" monitor and dock unless you prefer 27"  reply if you'd like to change. If you don't see the MDM email in 10 minutes tell me and I'll resend.

Harper Lin: Thanks all  I got the MDM email and started enrollment. Employee ID is E-88412. Also 24" is perfect. And happy to subject the team to ukulele during a post-intro hang if desired.

Samira Gomez: Added Harper to #platform and the onboarding doc. Intro circle at 11am PDT today  you'll meet the broader team then.

IT Support: MDM confirmed. Please upload your public key and open the registry ticket with subject "registry token request" and include E-88412. We'll respond within the hour.

Harper Lin: Uploaded public key and opened the ticket. Thanks for the quick help everyone! Looking forward to meeting you all. 

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: Welcome aboard Harper  see you at the intro circle (and maybe bring the uke).
